results.content: # Why you should do time series anomaly detection. Many papers claim to be doing time series anomaly detection. As a rule of thumb, if you can perfectly and unambiguously describe what you count as an anomaly, then you are not doing anomaly detection. i don;t think you can restrict anomaly detection to particular methods. But I agree with others, most anomaly detection algorithms, even those labelled as 'AI', are extremely crude. First, any anomaly detection should involve looking at the data. Detecting changes in pressures because of a valve control change is not an anomaly. Rewritten in its contrapositive form it is the following: If you are doing anomaly detection, then you cannot perfectly and unambiguously describe what you count as an anomaly.
